title: Symfony
intro: Applies to: Symfony controllers, services, Messenger message handlers, console commands.

entries.rule: Services **MUST NOT** be fetched with `$container->get()`; they **MUST** be autowired through the constructor. This is the Symfony form of the no-service-location rule in `php-core.md` (`laravel-kanon` skill).

Writes **MUST** go through a Symfony Messenger command dispatched to one handler, so every write shares one transaction and validation path. This is the Symfony counterpart of the Laravel command/handler slice (`architecture.md` in the `laravel-kanon` skill).
entries.why: every write shares one transaction and validation path
entries.lane_note: Laravel counterpart: ARCH-005 (command/handler write slice) and ARCH-009 (explicit handler wiring) in `architecture.md`.
